scientific_conclusion: The exact Stage-77 common-frame face field is strongly conservative-cancellation dominated: the cell-divergence absolute magnitude is only 8.50805% of the two-target face magnitude, while adjacent x-face correlation is 0.921815 and adjacent y-row correlation is 0.999711. The common-frame reconstruction agrees with the Stage-75 cell residual to 4.33698e-05 in relative L2 and its discrete divergence closes exactly. Therefore the scientifically justified next audit is to decompose the coherent face gradient into the three fixed heat-flux velocity moments. These are frozen residual-structure diagnostics, not adjoint sensitivities and not evidence that a modified solver would improve q_av.
positive_findings: The common-frame face-to-cell divergence closes exactly against the committed construction.
Adjacent x-face correlation exceeds the preregistered 0.90 coherence guard.
The audit uses exact completed Stage-67 and Stage-75 artifacts and performs no cavity rerun.
negative_findings: Large coherent face contributions cancel strongly under conservative divergence and therefore cannot be interpreted directly as heat-flux sensitivity.
The failed Stage-28 MUSCL endpoint remains unrecovered and is not extended to Kn0=0.1 or 10.
No physical, collision, correction-floor, source-relaxation, transport, wall, normalization, or velocity-quadrature parameter was retuned.
